summary: Iter125 — Tested SF↔EG bypass+chain-back, dashboard reshuffle, EG card restoration. CRITICAL: Found and fixed a JSX parse error in /app/frontend/app/tools/solution-finder.tsx (Modal placed as bare sibling inside the footer ternary at lines ~1325-1374) — this would have prevented the entire Solution Finder screen from rendering. Also fixed an undefined `id` reference in goToEmotionalReception (was `${id || ''}`, should use savedId). After fix, SF renders, navigation to /tools/solution-finder works, Step 0→1 transition works. EG hub renders cards 1-5 in the correct order. Tap on '5 · Solution Finder' routes to /tools/solution-finder ✓. Dashboard contains the new §10 Solution Space tiles (Solution Finder/Solution Store/Review Net/DEO/Time Store all present in body innerText) but RN ScrollView lazy-render plus my limited scroll made strict ordering check inconclusive (§9 found, §10 sectionTitle string not found in initial viewport). Two open issues for main agent: (a) the 6th 'Effective Outlets Advisor' card did NOT render on EG hub (body.innerText returns -1 for that title after the 5 numbered cards render correctly) — investigate whether a stale bundle/cache caused this; the source clearly defines it at lines 154-158 in emotional-gatekeeper.tsx. (b) Could not auto-tap the ⭐ star icon to promote the concern to primary (no testID on the star TouchableOpacity), so the sf-emo-gate modal flow couldn't be E2E-verified via Playwright — needs main-agent self-test or addition of testID='concern-star-<id>' for automation.

ui_bugs.issue: BLOCKING JSX syntax error — Modal placed as bare adjacent sibling inside the footer's `step < 5 ? (...) : (...)` ternary without a fragment wrapper. Eslint: 'Parsing error: ")" expected.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/tools/solution-finder.tsx:1331. FIXED by wrapping TouchableOpacity + Modal in <>...</>.

Used undefined variable `id` in template literal `return_id=${id || ''}` — would have caused ReferenceError when user clicks 'No — Emotional Reception first'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/tools/solution-finder.tsx:~719. FIXED to use savedId/fresh save result.

Effective Outlets Advisor card not present in rendered DOM (body.innerText.find returns -1) despite being defined in tools[] at lines 154-158. Screenshot shows 1·Reception → 2·Trap → 3·Loop → 4·Limitations → 5·Solution Finder, then directly Pending Commitments — Advisor card skipped. Reference: /app/frontend/app/tools/emotional-gatekeeper.tsx:154-158. Suspect cause: stale Metro bundle or visible-area lazy render; main agent should restart expo and verify.

Star ⭐ TouchableOpacity on concern row has no testID — automation cannot tap it to promote concern to PRIMARY, so the gate modal cannot be E2E-tested without manual interaction. Suggest testID like `concern-star-{id}` on the star TouchableOpacity. Reference: /app/frontend/app/tools/solution-finder.tsx:816

rca_of_issue: Root cause of broken iter125 SF screen: in /app/frontend/app/tools/solution-finder.tsx line 1325 the truthy branch of `{step < 5 ? (...) : (...)}` contained two adjacent JSX elements (the existing TouchableOpacity for 'Next' AND the new Modal for the emotional gate) without a fragment wrapper. JSX requires a single child expression in each branch of a conditional. Metro web bundler appeared to succeed only because the bundle cache served a pre-patch artifact during my initial probe; eslint detected the parse error immediately ('Parsing error: ")" expected.' at 1331:10). Reproduction: open /tools/solution-finder — screen would have shown a blank/red error or stale render. Mitigation applied: wrapped the TouchableOpacity + Modal pair in a React fragment <>...</>. Also fixed undefined `id` to use `savedId` (or the freshly-saved id returned by handleSave) so the vent deep-link carries the real entry ID for chain-back.
